page.overview:
Who is Blacksmith's Wife?

The is the wife of the and the mother of . She is upbeat and kindhearted, offering to make breakfast after her husband had scolded him for being late to work. After traps in a , goes missing. She and her husband grow increasingly concerned over his disappearance, until rescues him from the . In her relief, she plans on making 's favorite dessert to celebrate his return.

After rescues from , the princess leaves him in the middle of a road near the Lorulean Blacksmith's shop. The Lorulean brings him back to her home to save him from the dangers in . Once she sees that the young hero is in good health, she kicks him out of her home, disgusted that she committed nice acts. Humorously, she mentions that was mumbling the name , her Hyrulean counterpart's son, but she dismisses it as an unacceptable name. After her husband sees the , she becomes confused by his change of mood and asks if was the cause of the vicissitude. However, once obtains the materials for her husband to forge him the , her passion for her husband is reignited at seeing his own returned vitality.
